# The prototype-cluster deletion map — one SURVIVING CONSUMER EDGE per line, in
# the form `<cluster module> <- <repo-relative consumer path>`, sorted.
#
# WHAT THIS IS. Each line names a consumer outside the cluster that still
# imports a cluster module. That import must be CUT before the module can be
# deleted, so this file is the deletion's work list and its ordering: a module
# with no line here is deletable now. Finding R-0830 is why the deletion is
# bounded by these edges rather than by F260's module list.
#
# HOW IT IS MAINTAINED. This file is GENERATED from the live import graph, never
# typed, and `test_cluster_deletion_map.py` holds it against that graph in both
# directions. THE DELETION ROUND REMOVES A LINE IN THE SAME COMMIT THAT CUTS ITS
# EDGE — a cut whose line is left behind reds the test just as a new edge does.
#
# Blank lines and lines beginning with `#` are ignored by the reader.
